_doc: Safari Zone (southwest)'s buildings and props (warp-only map: group 'standalone', its own exterior pack, data/buildings/standalone.json, b2tools/models_standalone.py). buildings: Sapphire door destination -> res and front (z of the model's front wall; world.py puts it 4 units into the door tile, footprint centre from data/plans); props: model origin in Sapphire map tile coordinates (footprint centre x, door row + (4 - 20)/16 for a building), 'covers': map tile rects the model stands on (no ground-module plinths there). The rest house is towns1 res 322 (pack 0).
